stats.name: Edge
stats.description: Quickness, agility, and prowess when fighting at a distance.

stats.name: Heart
stats.description: Courage, willpower, empathy, sociability, and loyalty.

stats.name: Iron
stats.description: Physical strength, endurance, aggressiveness, and prowess when fighting at close quarters.

supply.description: Abstract representation of overall preparedness: food, water, fuel, weapons, ammo, equipment, cargo, money, and general upkeep. Shared among allies playing together.

impacts.effect: Each marked impact reduces max momentum (normally 10) by 1. Momentum reset is also reduced: +1 with one impact marked, 0 with more than one.

misfortunes.trigger: Sacrifice Resources reduces you to 0 supply

vehicle_troubles.trigger: vehicle at 0 integrity, failed Withstand Damage
command vehicle at 0 integrity, failed Withstand Damage

burdens.clears_via: resolve a quest to prevent a dire future

progress_tracks.note: Momentum is ignored on progress rolls.

assets.note: Deed assets are earned through play and are not available to choose at character creation.

steps.name: Ready your assets
steps.text: Sort your available assets by category: Paths, Companions, Support Vehicles, and Modules. Set Deed assets aside — they're earned through play, not chosen now.

steps.name: Choose two paths
steps.text: Pick two Path assets to represent your background, training, or calling.

steps.name: Create your backstory
steps.text: Envision your character's history — who they were before they took up the mantle of Ironsworn.

steps.name: Write your background vow
steps.text: Swear an Iron Vow to represent your character's long-term driving goal.

steps.name: Board your starship
steps.text: Take the Starship command vehicle asset and give it a name.

steps.name: Choose your final asset
steps.text: Pick one more asset from the Path, Companion, Support Vehicle, or Module categories.

steps.name: Set your stats
steps.text: Arrange 3, 2, 2, 1, 1 across edge, heart, iron, shadow, and wits in any order.

steps.name: Set your condition meters
steps.text: Set health, spirit, and supply to +5, and momentum to +2 (max +10, reset +2). Any vehicle or companion asset starts at max health or integrity.

steps.name: Envision your character
steps.text: Define one or two facts about how they look, how they act, and what they wear.

steps.name: Name your character
steps.text: Give them a name, and consider a callsign and pronouns.

steps.name: Gear up
steps.text: Note any important equipment or personal items. You're otherwise assumed to be equipped with a spacer kit and whatever your supply meter represents.
